6.389 rsInvalidSortDirectionMustNotBeSpecified
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidSortDirectionMustNotBeSpecified is a critical error that occurs when
JoinCondition.SortDirection is specified and NaturalJoin is false on the containing Relationship or
DefaultRelationship.
